agent.summary: The scene is a small paved patio behind a brick house, filmed at dusk. It has a large sliding glass door into a lit living room, and dark fences and dense trees and bushes around the other sides. I made 6 surfaces into rules and set everything else to ignore. **Solid:** the brick house wall (#0), after cutting off the part that ran into the bushes to the right of the door, plus the thin wall strip beside the door (#31). I also merged five overlapping floor patches (#38, #34, #4, #6, #36) into one solid paving surface (#42). **Glass:** the pipeline had missed the door, so I added it as a new surface (#41), fitted to the door frame, so the reflections and the view into the room get painted onto it instead of becoming floating blobs. **Soft:** the planting-bed ground under the bushes (#39, #40) and the mixed paving-and-bed area (#35). I didn't separate the paving inside #35, so part of it is treated as soft rather than solid; that loses some flattening there but carves nothing away. **Ignore:** the interior floor seen through the glass (#37), a small sliver by the door (#5), and the many sloped or wall-like cuts through foliage, trees and sky. Two things are still loose. From above, the house wall #0 still reaches well past the patio to the east, and a few small bits of it still sit on the bushes next to the door in some photos. I left both as they are.
